query: I have a 90-year-old female patient. Among female Medicare patients aged 85–95 who were transferred from another hospital with a principal diagnosis of osteomyelitis, how many index admissions meet these criteria in the MIMIC‑IV dataset during the study period?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS index_admission_count
FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions a
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p
  ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd d
  ON a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses dd
  ON d.icd_code = dd.icd_code
  AND d.icd_version = dd.icd_version
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
  AND (p.anchor_age + EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - p.anchor_year) BETWEEN 85 AND 95
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND LOWER(a.admission_location) LIKE '%transfer%'
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%osteomyelitis%';
